absent: Allowed flag mask bits and selector validation rules.
Breakpoint slot count and length, type and control encodings.
Reserved and polarity definitions for virtual status and control images.
Freezing and locking guarantees for traced register and breakpoint access.
Register view contents and floating regset layouts.
Breakpoint address validity and allocation failure contract.
TLS window values and descriptor field widths.

findings.text: Native architecture ptrace entry routes user area word access, bulk integer and floating state transfer, thread descriptor operations where configured, 64-bit TLS control, and fallback to common handling for other requests.

Compatibility ptrace entry provides word and bulk access to the 32-bit register view plus extended floating state, reusing native handling for thread area work and a compatibility fallback for the remainder.
Public disable hook tears down single stepping state for a traced task when tracing ends.
Single step teardown clears block stepping, single step marking and exit trap work, and removes the trap flag only when this layer introduced it.
Block step control updates branch trap behavior together with its thread flag and refreshes hardware state for the running task.
Thread area lookup resolves a TLS slot, hardens the index, expands the kernel descriptor into user form and copies it out.
Flag readout hides a debugger introduced trap bit while flag install preserves such a bit unless the caller supplies it, limiting changes to an allowed mask.
General register word access separates selectors, flags and address sized bases from plain slots, rejecting base updates outside the task address limit on 64-bit.
Bulk integer register streaming walks slots in order and supports kernel and user buffers, stopping on the first transfer or install failure.
Hardware breakpoint notification records which slot fired by setting the matching position in a per-thread virtual status accumulator.
Debug control readout combines only active slots by encoding each slot length and access kind into its control position.
Control update reconciles every slot toward the requested enable map, creating missing entries and adjusting existing ones, then retries once from the prior image when the first attempt fails.
Debug register view maps low numbers to breakpoint addresses, treats two middle numbers as invalid, and exposes adjusted virtual status and cached control images at the top numbers.
Breakpoint address install creates an initially inactive entry with default shape when absent and otherwise updates the existing entry address in place.
Permission bitmap regset reports present size scaled by element width and refuses readout when no bitmap is attached.
Block step flag and debug control change together with interrupts masked, refreshing the hardware register only when the affected task is currently running.
User influenced slot numbers for debug and TLS access are constrained with speculation safe clamping before table lookup.
Observed per-thread state includes a breakpoint slot table, virtual status and control images, I/O bitmap pointer, TLS array, saved base addresses and step related flags.
User visible layouts distinguish a native register block plus debug array from a 32-bit register block plus debug array, with separate floating and extended floating areas selected by regset.

32-bit compatibility routes selector writes through native handling, refreshes bases after selector changes, funnels flags and debug slots through common helpers, and marks syscall number overrides for restart handling.
TLS descriptor export clears the user record then derives base, limit and attribute booleans from packed hardware fields including long mode where present.
Separate native 32-bit and 64-bit register views back architecture ptrace dispatch.
Debug interface numbers low slots as address slots, treats the next two values as nonexistent, and reserves the top two for status and control.
Native and compatibility interfaces select general, floating and extended floating regsets and distinguish word peek and poke from bulk get and set plus thread area operations.
TLS slot identifiers are validated against a fixed architectural minimum to maximum window with special handling for a sentinel requesting indirect lookup.
